name: Streax Professional 100ml Argan Secrets Colour Protect Hair Serum for Women | Enriched with Argan Oil & UV Filter | Prevents Frizz | Provides Instant Shine & Smoothness | Enhances Radiance of Hair
description:
Streax Professional Argan Secrets Colour Protect Hair Serum – 100ml
Product of India

Protect, nourish, and enhance your coloured hair with Streax Professional Argan Secrets Colour Protect Hair Serum. Specially designed for women, this serum prevents frizz, provides instant shine and smoothness, and helps maintain the vibrancy of coloured hair.

Key Features & Benefits:

Colour Protection: Advanced Colour Reinforcer Technology and UV filter help retain hair colour longer while keeping hair soft and manageable.

Frizz Control & Smoothness: Instantly tames frizz, leaving hair silky and smooth.

Enriched with Argan Oil: Nourishes hair deeply, improving texture and radiance.

Enhances Hair Vibrancy: Restores shine and vibrancy, making coloured hair look healthy and luminous.

Formulated for Indian Hair: Combines international technology with insights into Indian hair types for optimal results.

Size: 100ml
Made in India

Ideal for daily use, this serum keeps coloured hair protected, nourished, and stunningly radiant.
